title: Mweya Uri Seri kweChifananidzo
intro: Mumumvuri wekubuda kukuru kubva muudzvinyiriri, munhu uyu asinganzwisisike akamirira murenje. Mutungamiriri wevanhu vakasarudzwa paakakwira pagomo dzvene kuti awane chirairo chaMwari, muedzo mukuru wakawira pamusoro peavo vakasara. Munhu uyu akatora mukana uyu kuti agadzirise zvitendero zvenharaunda yese. Mutungamiriri paakadzoka nechokwadi, chirango chakasiyana uye chisingaperi chakatemwa. Unogona here kutsanangura kuti mweya uyu une nharo uye wakangwara waive ani?
clues: Ndakafamba nevanhu vakanga vasunungurwa kubva muruoko rwemudzvinyiriri ane simba kuburikidza nezviratidzo zvinoshamisa.
Mutungamiriri wavo paakakwira kugomo kunotora gwara, ndakamira pakati pevakasara.
Ndakaunganidza simbi inokosha kubva muzvishongo zvavo ndikaigadzira kuita chimwe chinhu chaiburitsa ruzha.
Kuburikidza nekusikwa uku, ndakaita kuti chizvarwa chose chigutsikane kuti vakanga vawana mwari wavo murenje.
Mutungamiriri paakadzoka, ndakasarudzwa ndikabvunzwa kuti chii chakaita kuti ndinyengere zvakadaro.
Chirango changu munyika ino chaive chekuti hapana aizondibata kana kuswedera pedyo, chiratidzo chekunyara kwandinogara nako nekusingaperi.

outcome.answer: Anotongerwa kuva asingabatike, achigara achiti 'hapana chekubata'

arabic: قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًۭا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا
verse: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it [i.e., its ashes] into the sea with a blast. (20:97)
